h1: Butterfly Hotel Betong — A New Design Boutique on Prachathipat Road, Spacious Rooms with Bathtubs
intro: If you want a Betong stay that feels new, clean and more modern than the town's older hotels — Butterfly Hotel Betong is a design boutique on Prachathipat Road that reviewers keep praising for spacious rooms, bathrooms with tubs and a quiet atmosphere. The building was renovated in 2022 and has a large parking lot with 24-hour security · from approx. THB 900/night · scored 8.3 from 109 Trip.com reviews.

body.html: Most places to stay in Betong are guesthouses or older in-town hotels. Butterfly Hotel Betong stands out as a newer, design-led building, renovated around 2022 and set on Prachathipat Road. What guests mention most is how new and clean it feels — both the rooms and the common areas still look fresh rather than worn-in like long-established hotels.

Rooms here are bigger than the price suggests. Many have a generous bathroom with a bathtub, something you rarely find in similarly priced Betong hotels. Genuine reviews mention strong water pressure plus a kettle, fridge and hair dryer in the room. Soft beds, cold air-con and a quiet feel make this a comfortable place to actually rest, especially after a full day on the road.
"New and clean hotel, spacious rooms, lovely bathroom with a tub, strong water pressure, big parking lot, quiet and great for resting."

Parking is the feature road-trippers love most. The lot is large, partly shaded, and watched by security 24 hours a day. For a drive in from Hat Yai or Yala town, having safe, easy parking means you can start exploring with peace of mind. Staff also earn praise for being friendly and helpful.

Common areas include a bar, a massage room, a hot tub and karaoke rooms for an evening out. There is no swimming pool, and some reviews note it doesn't yet have a full in-house restaurant or fitness centre — if you want full resort-style facilities, this isn't the answer. But for travellers who prioritise a good room and convenient parking, what's on offer fits an overnight Betong trip well.

Two honest caveats. First, the location is about 1–1.5 km from the town centre — roughly a 20-minute walk, but if you'll head to the Betong Mongkonritthi Tunnel, the OK Betong sign or the night market often, a car is far handier. Second, the walls aren't thick, so you can sometimes hear neighbours or the corridor, and a few reviews mention the shower running hot-then-cold inconsistently.

In short, Butterfly Hotel Betong suits travellers who want a new, clean, modern-design room with a bathtub and easy parking at an accessible price. It's not a walk-everywhere central location and has no pool, but on value and the freshness of the rooms, its 8.3 from 109 reviews reflects guests who got what they paid for.

faq.q: Where in Betong is Butterfly Hotel · is it walkable?
faq.a: It sits at 188 Prachathipat Road, Betong · about 1–1.5 km from the town centre, roughly a 20-minute walk · the Betong Mongkonritthi Tunnel, OK Betong sign and night market are about a 5-minute drive · for frequent trips into town, a car or ride is handier than walking.

faq.q: What's the starting price · what room types are there?
faq.a: From approx. THB 900/night for a Standard Room · plus Superior (with bathtub), Junior Suite and Family Room for families · prices vary by season and holidays, so compare a few platforms before booking.

No swimming pool · this is a design boutique focused on fresh rooms and convenient parking · it has a bar, massage room, hot tub and karaoke · for a pool in Betong, look at resort-style stays instead.

faq.q: Are the rooms noisy · can you sleep well?
faq.a: Some reviews note the walls aren't very thick, so you can sometimes hear neighbouring rooms or the corridor · if you're a light sleeper, ask for a corner room or a quieter floor at check-in, and bring earplugs.

Best for travellers wanting a new, clean room with a bathtub and road trips needing easy parking · spacious modern-design rooms, a large lot and 24-hr security · less ideal if you want a walk-everywhere central location or a pool — in that case a central hotel or resort fits better.
